# fianu_platform (Resource)

Manages a Fianu platform — the integration product (GitHub, Jira, Slack) that instances connect to. The platform carries the operational contract every instance of it inherits: endpoint defaults, health probes, credential rotation, error semantics and audit policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A platform is the integration product instances connect to. Everything here
# is the contract every instance of it inherits — endpoint defaults, health
# probes, credential rotation, error semantics, audit policy — so getting it
# right once saves repeating it per instance.
#
# `platform_type` references a Console-managed platform type by UUID, the same
# way fianu_collection references a domain.

resource "fianu_platform" "github" {
  path = "f.platform.github"
  name = "GitHub"

  detail = {
    description  = "GitHub source control and CI"
    display_logo = "github"
    website_url  = "https://github.com"
    docs_url     = "https://docs.github.com"
    tool_version = "2024.11"

    platform_type = {
      name = "Source Control"
      uuid = var.source_control_platform_type_uuid
    }

    features = {
      webhooks = "true"
      apps     = "true"
    }

    sources = {
      produces = [
        { path = "github.repository.commit", note = "origin" },
        { path = "github.pull_request.review", note = "attestation" },
      ]
    }

    endpoint_defaults = {
      base_url = "https://api.github.com"
      notes    = "Public GitHub. Enterprise Server instances override per instance."
      default_headers = jsonencode({
        Accept = "application/vnd.github+json"
      })
    }

    # Probes deciding whether an instance is usable. `critical` failures take
    # the instance out of service rather than just annotating it.
    health_checks = [
      {
        check_key         = "api_reachable"
        description       = "API answers and the token still has quota"
        http_method       = "GET"
        endpoint_template = "/rate_limit"
        interval_seconds  = 60
        timeout_ms        = 5000
        retry_max         = 3
        retry_backoff_ms  = 250
        severity          = "critical"
        enabled           = true
        success_predicate = jsonencode({ status_in = [200] })
      },
    ]

    credential_policy = {
      rotation             = "proactive"
      grace_period_seconds = 300
      notes                = "App installation tokens expire hourly."
      reauth_triggers      = jsonencode({ on_status = [401] })
    }

    # Turns provider-specific failures into Fianu's error semantics, so the
    # collector knows whether to back off, re-auth, or give up.
    error_mappings = [
      {
        http_status    = 429
        classification = "rate_limit"
        action         = "backoff"
        is_terminal    = false
      },
      {
        http_status    = 401
        classification = "auth"
        action         = "reauth"
        is_terminal    = false
      },
      {
        http_status    = 404
        classification = "not_found"
        action         = "fail"
        is_terminal    = true
        endpoint_glob  = "/repos/*"
      },
    ]

    audit_policy = {
      level              = "info"
      pii_handling       = "redact"
      redact_fields      = ["author_email", "committer_email"]
      retention_days     = 90
      export_destination = "s3://fianu-logs/github/"
      sampling_rate      = 0.25
    }
  }
}

variable "source_control_platform_type_uuid" {
  type        = string
  description = "UUID of the Console-managed 'Source Control' platform type."
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `detail` (Attributes) Platform payload — mirrors the spec.yaml structure used by `fianu console deploy`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail))
- `name` (String) Display name of the entity.
- `path` (String) Human-readable entity key (slug). Immutable — changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `children` (List of String) Child entity references. Server-derived; do not author manually.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form key/value metadata. Server may augment with creator/timestamps.
- `parents` (List of String) Parent entity references. Server populates them from cross-entity relationships.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite resource identifier in the form `<entity_type>/<entity_key>` (e.g., `control/payment-service-sast`). Used by `terraform import`.
- `uuid` (String) Server-generated UUID. Stable across versions of the entity.
- `version` (Attributes) Server-managed version envelope. Every partial update bumps `semantic` and regenerates `uuid` + `timestamp` server-side, so the object is NOT pinned via UseStateForUnknown — plans correctly show `(known after apply)` on any change, and Create/Update refetch the entity post-deploy to populate from server truth. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--version))

<a id="nestedatt--detail"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail`

Optional:

- `audit_policy` (Attributes) Logging, PII handling and retention for this platform's traffic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--audit_policy))
- `credential_policy` (Attributes) How credentials for this platform are rotated and when re-authentication is forced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--credential_policy))
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the platform.
- `display_logo` (String) Logo identifier used by the Console's own icon set.
- `docs_url` (String) Vendor documentation.
- `endpoint_defaults` (Attributes) Default HTTP endpoint configuration every instance of this platform inherits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--endpoint_defaults))
- `error_mappings` (Attributes List) Translates provider-specific failures into Fianu's error semantics, so the collector knows whether to retry, back off, re-auth, or give up. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--error_mappings))
- `features` (Map of String) Free-form feature flags for this platform, as string key/value pairs.
- `health_checks` (Attributes List) Probes that decide whether an instance of this platform is usable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--health_checks))
- `logo_url` (String) Externally hosted logo image.
- `platform_type` (Attributes) The platform type this platform belongs to. Platform types are Console-managed — there is no `fianu_platform_type` resource yet — so supply the `uuid` of an existing one, the same way `fianu_collection` references a domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--platform_type))
- `sources` (Attributes) What this entity consumes and produces. The server records each entry as an edge and enforces that every `consumes` has a matching active `produces` somewhere, so a consumer declared against a path nothing publishes is rejected at deploy time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--sources))
- `tool_version` (String) Version of the platform integration itself (not the entity version).
- `website_url` (String) Vendor website.

<a id="nestedatt--detail--audit_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.audit_policy`

Required:

- `level` (String) Log level. One of `debug`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `critical`.
- `pii_handling` (String) How personally identifiable information in logs is treated. One of `redact`, `hash`, `encrypt`, `allow`.

Optional:

- `event_catalog` (String) Structured event catalog as a JSON object. Author with `jsonencode({...})`.
- `export_destination` (String) Where logs are shipped, e.g. `s3://fianu-logs/github/`.
- `redact_fields` (List of String) Field names to redact before logs are written.
- `retention_days` (Number) How long logs are kept.
- `sampling_rate` (Number) Fraction of events logged, between 0.0 and 1.0.


<a id="nestedatt--detail--credential_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.credential_policy`

Required:

- `rotation` (String) Rotation stance. One of `proactive`, `reactive`, `manual`, `disabled`.

Optional:

- `grace_period_seconds` (Number) Clock-skew buffer applied around credential expiry.
- `notes` (String) Free-form operator notes.
- `reauth_triggers` (String) Conditions that force re-authentication, as a JSON object. Author with `jsonencode({...})`.


<a id="nestedatt--detail--endpoint_defaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.endpoint_defaults`

Required:

- `base_url` (String) Canonical public base endpoint, e.g. `https://api.github.com`.

Optional:

- `default_headers` (String) Headers sent on every request, as a JSON object. Author with `jsonencode({ Accept = "application/vnd.github+json" })`.
- `notes` (String) Free-form operator notes.


<a id="nestedatt--detail--error_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.error_mappings`

Required:

- `action` (String) What to do when this rule matches. One of `retry`, `fail`, `ignore`, `reauth`, `backoff`.
- `classification` (String) Fianu error class. One of `auth`, `permission`, `rate_limit`, `quota`, `not_found`, `transient`, `invalid_request`, `conflict`, `server`, `unknown`.

Optional:

- `contains_text` (String) Substring match against the response body or message.
- `endpoint_glob` (String) Endpoint pattern this rule is scoped to, e.g. `/repos/*`.
- `http_status` (Number) HTTP status this rule matches. Omit for non-HTTP failures.
- `is_terminal` (Boolean) Whether this failure ends the operation rather than being retried.
- `notes` (String) Free-form operator notes.
- `provider_code` (String) Provider-specific error code this rule matches.


<a id="nestedatt--detail--health_checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.health_checks`

Required:

- `check_key` (String) Stable identifier for this check, e.g. `api_reachable`, `token_valid`.
- `endpoint_template` (String) Path appended to the platform's base URL, e.g. `/rate_limit`.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method for the probe request.

Optional:

- `body_template` (String) Request body as a JSON object. Author with `jsonencode({...})`.
- `description` (String) What this check proves.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this check runs. Omitted means off, matching the server's zero value.
- `header_template` (String) Request headers as a JSON object. Author with `jsonencode({...})`.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) How often to run the check.
- `retry_backoff_ms` (Number) Backoff between retries in milliseconds.
- `retry_max` (Number) Maximum retries before the check is considered failed.
- `severity` (String) How bad a failure of this check is. One of `pending`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `critical`.
- `success_predicate` (String) JSON predicate deciding success, e.g. `jsonencode({ status_in = [200] })`.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds.


<a id="nestedatt--detail--platform_type"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.platform_type`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Display name of the platform type.
- `uuid` (String) Entity UUID of the platform type.


<a id="nestedatt--detail--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.sources`

Optional:

- `consumes` (Attributes List) Inputs this entity reads. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--sources--consumes))
- `produces` (Attributes List) Outputs this entity publishes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--sources--produces))

<a id="nestedatt--detail--sources--consumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.sources.consumes`

Required:

- `path` (String) Event or data path, e.g. `slack.message.sent`.

Optional:

- `integration` (Attributes) The integration on the other end. Set whichever identifier you have — the server resolves `path` or `name` to an entity, and `entity_id` pins it across renames. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--sources--consumes--integration))
- `note` (String) Note type this edge carries. One of `attestation`, `origin`, `occurrence`, `transaction`, `association`.
- `schema` (String) OpenAPI schema for the payload, as a JSON string. Author it with `jsonencode({...})` — the shape is free-form, so HCL can't type it.

<a id="nestedatt--detail--sources--consumes--integration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.sources.consumes.integration`

Optional:

- `entity_id` (String) Integration entity UUID. Pins the reference across renames.
- `name` (String) Integration name, e.g. `slack`.
- `path` (String) Integration entity key. Alternative to `name`.
- `type` (String) Integration entity type — `platform` or `tool`.



<a id="nestedatt--detail--sources--produces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.sources.produces`

Required:

- `path` (String) Event or data path, e.g. `slack.message.sent`.

Optional:

- `integration` (Attributes) The integration on the other end. Set whichever identifier you have — the server resolves `path` or `name` to an entity, and `entity_id` pins it across renames. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--detail--sources--produces--integration))
- `note` (String) Note type this edge carries. One of `attestation`, `origin`, `occurrence`, `transaction`, `association`.
- `schema` (String) OpenAPI schema for the payload, as a JSON string. Author it with `jsonencode({...})` — the shape is free-form, so HCL can't type it.

<a id="nestedatt--detail--sources--produces--integration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `detail.sources.produces.integration`

Optional:

- `entity_id` (String) Integration entity UUID. Pins the reference across renames.
- `name` (String) Integration name, e.g. `slack`.
- `path` (String) Integration entity key. Alternative to `name`.
- `type` (String) Integration entity type — `platform` or `tool`.





<a id="nestedatt--version"></a>
### Nested Schema for `version`

Read-Only:

- `semantic` (String) Semantic version (e.g., `1.0.0` or `5`).
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state. May be mutated by server-side workflows.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status. May be mutated by server-side workflows.
- `timestamp` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the version was created.
- `uuid` (String) Per-version UUID. Changes whenever the server creates a new version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fianu_platform.github platform/f.platform.github
```
